create_PredictionToGroundTruthSampler: create a PredictionToGroundTruthSampler instance with a dataset name to convert predictions to ground truth
call_PredictionToGroundTruthSampler: run the sampler on a list of model outputs to transform predictions into ground truth data
register_sampler: register a new sampler mapping a prediction attribute to a ground truth attribute with an optional function
remove_sampler: remove an existing sampler for a given prediction and ground truth attribute pair
review_Sampler_dataclass: review the _Sampler dataclass that holds source, destination, and function fields for sampler registry entries
